theme_central: Abundance (al-Kawthar) granted to the Prophet, in answer to those who called him cut off from posterity — it is in fact his detractor who will be so.
sources_note: Universally known content, no possible divergence.

branches.title: Abundance granted
branches.resume: Allah has granted the Prophet Abundance (al-Kawthar).

branches.title: Prayer, sacrifice, answer to enemies
branches.resume: Perform the prayer and the sacrifice; it is the Prophet's detractor who will be cut off from posterity.

children.t: Prayer and sacrifice; the detractor will be cut off from posterity
